channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro se encontra com Eduardo Cunha em BH
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator and pre-candidate for president in 2026, met with former deputy Eduardo Cunha in Belo Horizonte on Tuesday (2). During the meeting, Flávio gave an interview to a radio station linked to Cunha and spoke about tax burden, entrepreneurship, and social programs. Cunha, who was removed from office and arrested in Operation Lava Jato and announced his candidacy for federal deputy from MG in 2026, stated that Flávio has taken on the mission of leading the conservative field in the 2026 election.

item.title: Diretor-geral da PF defende novo inquérito para investigar recursos de Vorcaro para ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: Federal Police Director-General Andrei Rodrigues advocated for a new investigation into Daniel Vorcaro's transfer of funds to the U.S. under the guise of financing the film 'Dark Horse', proposing three procedural paths: merging with the 'Master case' (STF, rapporteur Justice André Mendonça), incorporating into the existing inquiry on Eduardo Bolsonaro's U.S. activities (Justice Alexandre de Moraes), or random assignment to another STF justice. Rodrigues also denounced the classification of PCC and CV as terrorist groups as a 'technical error' that undermines effective crime-fighting.

item.title: TSE rejeita recursos e mantém Cláudio Castro inelegível
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) unanimously upheld the ineligibility of former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro (PL) for abuse of political and economic power in a scheme involving the irregular hiring of tens of thousands of campaign workers. While the court corrected the legal basis of the fine imposed, it rejected the Electoral Public Ministry’s request to formally annul Castro’s and ex-vice-governor Thiago Pampolha’s diplomas, maintaining that the mandate’s cancellation was moot due to their resignation one day before the ruling.

item.title: TSE rejeita recurso da defesa e mantém condenação de Cláudio Castro
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) unanimously upheld the conviction of former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro for abuse of political and economic power in the 2022 elections, rendering him ineligible until 2030. While the Court rejected the Electoral Prosecution’s request to formally annul his diploma, a disagreement remains over whether his resignation nullifies the cassation, with direct implications for whether the state will hold direct or indirect elections to fill the vacancy.

item.title: Tarifa dos EUA ameaça 21% das exportações e governo busca acordo
item.description: The U.S. government recommended a 25% additional tariff on part of Brazilian exports, which could affect 21% of Brazil's total sales to the U.S. The Lula administration said it will continue negotiating to avoid the measure, emphasizing that issues like Pix, financial sovereignty, and environmental policies are non-negotiable. Talks continue until July 15, with a new meeting scheduled in Paris during an OECD event.

item.title: Auditoria interna da Cedae aponta prejuízo de R$ 220 milhões com Master e roteiro semelhante ao do Rioprevidência
item.description: An internal audit by Cedae found the company may have lost over R$ 220 million in investments at Banco Master after the finance department ignored internal warnings about the bank’s deteriorating condition. The report reveals that investment rules were relaxed in September 2023 to match Banco Master’s profile, which had initially been deemed ineligible due to its substandard risk rating and single-agency evaluation. The investigation suggests possible negligence, systemic misconduct, fraud, and asset risk, implicating former finance director Antonio Carlos dos Santos.

item.title: Sob protestos, Flávio Bolsonaro recebe título de cidadão honorário de Belo Horizonte
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro received the honorary citizenship title of Belo Horizonte amid protests, in a ceremony attended by political allies, organized fan groups, and displays of pro-Trump and pro-Bolsonaro banners. During the event, he accused President Lula of threatening him with death and inciting criminal factions, stating he would file a complaint with the STF. Lula had previously criticized Flávio for allegedly encouraging U.S. trade sanctions against Brazil, likening him to a traitor of the nation.

item.title: Lula volta a responsabilizar família Bolsonaro por tarifas dos EUA
item.description: President Lula blamed the Bolsonaro family for the U.S. announcement of a 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, citing Flávio Bolsonaro’s meeting with Trump and alleging the senator sought intervention in Brazil’s Pix system. He called the family 'traitors' during a hospital inauguration in Goiás. The tariffs follow a USTR investigation into alleged unfair practices, including digital commerce, ethanol access, and intellectual property.

item.title: As candidaturas sem Defesa e o desabafo do ministro: munição de guerra do Brasil dura apenas 30 dias
item.description: Defense Minister José Múcio warned that Brazil has ammunition sufficient for only 30 days of conflict, criticizing the lack of budget predictability for the Armed Forces. His remarks came after the Lula government froze R$ 4.4 billion in military spending—the largest cut among ministries—while the U.S. designated PCC and CV as terrorist organizations. No 2026 presidential pre-candidate commented on the budget freeze, with Flávio Bolsonaro focused on concealing the origin of his wealth and others prioritizing only public security, leaving national defense absent from the electoral debate.

item.title: TSE rejeita recursos de Cláudio Castro, mantém ex-governador inelegível e deixa para STF decidir sobre eleição do Rio
item.description: The TSE upheld Claudio Castro’s ineligibility until 2030, rejecting appeals from his defense and the cassated deputy Rodrigo Bacellar. The decision leaves it to the STF to determine whether Rio de Janeiro’s succession will be by direct popular vote or indirect legislative appointment, as Castro resigned prior to the cassation. The Electoral Public Ministry argues that the cassation of the diploma—not just the mandate—should apply, since resignation does not bar punishment for political and economic power abuse.

item.title: Sem provas, Flávio diz que fala de Lula é recado para PCC e CV o executarem
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, claimed without evidence that President Lula (PT) sent a message to criminal factions PCC and CV to have him killed. He made the statement after advocating for the U.S. to designate PCC and CV as foreign terrorist organizations, which he argues could justify U.S. intervention in Brazil.

item.title: Mensagens indicam que Vorcaro priorizou pagamentos ao filme 'Dark Horse' após pedido de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Messages between Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, and his brother-in-law Fabiano Zettel reveal that the banker prioritized payments of R$ 61 million to the film 'Dark Horse', about the life of Jair Bolsonaro, following a request from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The conversations, obtained by The Intercept and confirmed by TV Globo, show intermediaries like Thiago Miranda pushing to accelerate the transfers, with Vorcaro expressing interest in monitoring the process. The transfer is under investigation by the Federal Police, while Zettel reported outstanding payments of R$ 55.5 million.

item.title: O que Flávio Bolsonaro foi fazer com Cunha em Minas Gerais
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro met with former Chamber of Deputies president Eduardo Cunha in Belo Horizonte, where Cunha stated that Flávio had been tasked with leading the conservative field in the 2026 elections. In an interview with Rádio 89 Maravilha, aimed at an evangelical audience, Flávio discussed economic strengthening proposals, focusing on agribusiness and infrastructure. Cunha, who was removed from office in 2016 and investigated in Operation Car Wash, plans to run for a seat in the Chamber of Deputies from Minas Gerais.

item.title: Cabo Gilberto vê responsabilidade de Lula em tarifa americana
item.description: The leader of the opposition in the Chamber of Deputies, Cabo Gilberto (PL-PB), held President Lula responsible for the U.S. proposal to impose a 25% tariff on Brazilian products, stating that the measure is concerning due to its potential impact on the national economy and demanding a government response.

item.title: Nunes Marques é sorteado relator de queixa-crime de Michelle contra Janones
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Nunes Marques has been appointed as rapporteur for the criminal complaint filed by former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro against federal deputy André Janones, seeking at least R$20,000 in moral damages. The complaint, filed on May 25, alleges offensive statements made by Janones.

item.title: TSE mantém decisão que tornou Cláudio Castro inelegível até 2030
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) unanimously upheld the ineligibility of former Rio de Janeiro governor Cláudio Castro (PL) until 2030 for abuse of political and economic power during the 2022 campaign, involving improper use of the Ceperj and UERJ structures to hire electoral cabos. By a 5-2 vote, the TSE rejected the Electoral Public Prosecutor’s request to annul Castro’s diploma, though some ministers argued diploma cancellation should be mandatory given the severity of the conduct. The ruling emphasizes electoral legitimacy, despite Castro’s resignation prior to the judgment.

item.title: Ministério detalha setores mais afetados em caso de taxação pelos EUA
item.description: The Minister of Development, Industry, Commerce and Services, Márcio Elias Rosa, warned that a proposed 25% tariff by the United States on Brazilian products would affect 21% of Brazil’s exports, directly impacting sectors such as industrial machinery and equipment, plastics, footwear, wood products, paperboard, cast iron, and fish and crustaceans. He emphasized the harm to employment, income, and industry, and stressed that Brazil will not compromise on sovereignty, ruling out Pix from negotiations, while criticizing obstacles to dialogue with Washington, specifically naming Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for his White House agenda on classifying criminal factions as terrorists.

item.title: Fachin manifesta a relatora da ONU preocupação com ataques ao Judiciário e à democracia
item.description: Supreme Court President Edson Fachin expressed concern to UN Special Rapporteur Margaret Satterthwaite about attacks on judicial independence and democracy, emphasizing the importance of international cooperation in defending shared democratic values. He noted the STF's role in upholding democratic order during the 2022 coup attempt trial and warned of external pressures on the judiciary, such as unilateral sanctions, requiring heightened vigilance from democratic institutions.

item.title: Flávio diz que vai denunciar Lula ao STF por fala sobre enforcamento
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) announced he will file a complaint against Lula at the STF, claiming the president's statements constitute threats and incitement to crime, after Lula called Bolsonaro's sons worse than him and drew flawed historical comparisons. Lula, during the inauguration of a federal institute campus in Goiás, also labeled the Bolsonaro family a 'machine-gun family' and the 'worst type of human being' Brazil has produced, calling Flávio an 'imbecile' and a coward.

item.title: Zema critica vídeo divulgado pelo Irã: ‘Cristo jamais lutaria contra a liberdade’
item.description: Romeu Zema, pre-candidate for president from the Novo party, criticized a video disseminated by Iran's embassy depicting Christ the Redeemer fighting the Statue of Liberty, stating 'Christ would never fight against freedom'. He linked the video to the Lula government's alignment with authoritarian regimes, citing Vice President Geraldo Alckmin's attendance at the inauguration of Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian in 2024 and accusing Iran of supporting terrorism and violating human rights.

item.title: Camilo Santana diz que “família Bolsonaro defende os EUA”
item.description: Senator Camilo Santana (PT) criticized the Bolsonaro family for supporting the U.S. decision to impose a 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, claiming they are defending foreign intervention instead of national sovereignty. He recalled that Bolsonaro’s sons previously traveled to the U.S. to push for economically harmful measures, and now Flávio Bolsonaro is repeating the action. Santana praised President Lula for resisting Trump’s pressures without yielding to unilateral decisions, stressing that Brazil seeks to maintain relations with the U.S. while upholding its sovereignty.

item.title: Tarcísio critica tarifa dos EUA e cobra ação diplomática de Lula
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas criticized the U.S. proposal to impose a 25% tariff on Brazilian imports, warning it would harm Brazil’s industry, agribusiness, and jobs. He urged the federal government to intensify diplomatic efforts to prevent the measure, set for July 15, and challenged the validity of the U.S. investigation into Pix and other practices.

item.title: Tarcísio defende polícia após críticas de bolsonaristas
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas defended the autonomy of the Civil Police, stating that the state executive should not interfere in police operations. His remarks came in indirect response to criticism from Bolsonaro allies following a police action that targeted the producer of the film 'Darke Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro. Tarcísio sought to distance the government from allegations of political persecution.

item.title: Vorcaro priorizou pagamentos a filme de Bolsonaro após pedido de Flávio, indicam novas mensagens
item.description: Messages revealed by The Intercept and confirmed by TV Globo show that in January 2025, banker Daniel Vorcaro prioritized payments to a film about Jair Bolsonaro following direct pressure from Flávio Bolsonaro, a 2026 presidential pre-candidate. The conversations indicate the first installment of R$61 million was due on January 20, 2025, with Fabiano Zettel — Vorcaro’s brother-in-law, arrested in March 2026 during Operation Compliance Zero — acting as payment operator. Vorcaro confirmed payments amid complex financial flows, linking the film’s financing to political interests tied to the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro recebe título de cidadão honorário de BH sob atos de manifestantes contra e a favor
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) was awarded the honorary citizenship title of Belo Horizonte in a session at the Municipal Chamber, proposed by councilor Vile Santos (PL), who highlighted his role in electing his father president and strengthening the right in the city. The event was attended by political allies and organized fan groups, but also faced protests from opponents who labeled him an 'enemy of Brazil' and criticized the honor as a mockery of democracy and the city's real problems.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro diz esperar que tarifas não punam os brasileiros
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro denied that the proposed 25% U.S. tariffs on Brazilian products are linked to his and his brother Flávio's recent visit to the White House, calling the association a false narrative. He said he had extensive talks with Trump and is confident the president will not punish the Brazilian people for the actions of the Lula government. The Brazilian government claims the measure is politically motivated and was announced after the Bolsonaros' meeting with Trump.

item.title: 💥 Flávio e Lula trocam acusações pesadas após tarifaço de Trump
item.description: Former President Lula and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro exchanged heavy accusations following the imposition of U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods, dubbed the 'Trump tariff shock'. Lula criticized the U.S. government's stance and accused the opposition of exploiting the crisis to attack his administration, while Flávio Bolsonaro blamed Lula for Brazil's economic fragility and ineffective diplomatic response. The exchange unfolds amid rising trade tensions between Brazil and the U.S., with expected impacts on the agroexport sector.

item.title: EUA fazem movimento explícito de interferência nas eleições brasileiras, mas tiro pode 'sair pela culatra', avalia Planalto
item.description: Aides to President Lula claim that the U.S. government, driven by ideological factions led by Secretary of State Marco Rubio, is openly interfering in Brazil’s 2026 elections. This includes meetings between Flávio Bolsonaro and Donald Trump, proposed tariffs, labeling Brazilian criminal factions as terrorist organizations, and diplomatic isolation of Brazil. However, Planalto officials warn that such interference could backfire, as the growing association between Flávio Bolsonaro and Trump is fueling public rejection in Brazil due to Trump’s unpopularity.

item.title: Trump passa de 'aliado' de Flávio a maior estorvo do bolsonarismo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro faces a new setback after the Trump administration proposed imposing 25% tariffs on Brazilian exports by July 15, undermining the political gain he received from the U.S. designation of PCC and CV as terrorist groups. Once seen as benefiting from alignment with Trump, he must now adopt a defensive stance to mitigate damage to his 2026 presidential bid.

item.title: Escala 6x1: Alcolumbre diz que Senado não é obrigado a 'carimbar' texto da Câmara que reduz jornada
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre stated that the Senate is not obligated to 'rubber stamp' the Chamber's PEC reducing the workweek, insisting the proposal must go through committees before a floor vote. He emphasized that all matters must follow the regular legislative process, including review by the CCJ, to prevent the Senate from becoming merely an approval chamber for House decisions. Alcolumbre also noted requests to create a special committee to analyze the PEC, despite Senate rules traditionally limiting PEC review to the CCJ before plenary consideration.

item.title: Flávio diz que enviou carta a Rubio pedindo que EUA desistam de tarifas: ‘Causaria sérios prejuízos’
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, claims to have sent a letter to U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio urging the U.S. to abandon plans to impose 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods, warning it would cause serious harm to Brazil’s economy amid rising public debt, delinquency, and corporate insolvencies. He thanks Rubio for designating CV and PCC as terrorist organizations and expresses confidence in winning the October election, pledging to negotiate a broad trade and investment agreement if elected.

item.title: Ao vivo: TSE julga recursos contra inelegibilidade de Castro
item.description: The TSE is ruling on declaration embargos filed by the PGE regarding the ineligibility of Cláudio Castro (PL), former governor of Rio de Janeiro, focusing on whether resignation nullifies the electoral diploma cassation. The decision will directly influence Rio’s succession, either confirming interim governor Ricardo Couto or triggering new elections. The STF awaits this outcome to validate the current government’s continuity.

item.title: Tarcísio diz não interferir na autonomia da polícia, um dia após críticas de Nunes e Flávio
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) stated on Tuesday (2) that the São Paulo Police has autonomy to conduct its investigations, a day after criticism followed searches at addresses linked to the producer of the film 'Dark Horse' and a São Paulo City Hall secretary's office. He denied any interference in police operations, emphasizing respect for the independence of security forces.

item.title: Governo Lula retoma convênio com entidade ligada ao PT e investigada na máfia do INSS
item.description: The Lula government has reinstated a cooperation agreement with Contag, an entity under investigation by the Federal Police for unauthorized deductions of approximately R$ 2 billion from INSS retirees' pensions between 2019 and 2024. The agreement, unilaterally terminated in April, was reversed by INSS President Ana Cristina Viana Silveira following a review request. Contag has a documented history of close ties to Lula and the PT.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro visita Eduardo Cunha, mas omite encontro nas redes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro met with Eduardo Cunha, a longtime ally of former President Jair Bolsonaro, during a visit to Belo Horizonte, but did not disclose the meeting on his social media. The meeting took place Tuesday morning and was reported in an exclusive subscriber-only article.

item.title: Vorcaro priorizou recursos para 'Dark Horse' após pressão de Flávio Bolsonaro, diz site
item.description: Messages released by Intercept Brasil reveal that Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, prioritized funding for the film 'Dark Horse' after pressure from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The case raises suspicions of improper use of bank resources for personal or political purposes, potentially linked to Bolsonaro family interests. The disclosure occurred on June 2, 2026, at 5:33 PM, sparking debate over transparency and political influence in the financial sector.

item.title: Alcolumbre diz que parlamentares cobram CPMI do Master 'para fazer palanque eleitoral'
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre rejected the installation of a CPMI to investigate Banco Master, claiming the move is intended for electoral campaigning ('palanque eleitoral') and that investigations are already underway by the Federal Police, Federal Prosecutor's Office, and Brazilian Justice. He argued the congressional session was held to benefit municipalities by overturning Lula's veto on public donations, and stated that reading the CPMI request is a discretionary act of the presidency.

item.title: Vorcaro priorizou pagamentos a filme de Bolsonaro após cobrança de Flávio, diz site
item.description: Former banker Daniel Vorcaro prioritized payments for the film Dark Horse, which portrays the life of Jair Bolsonaro, following pressure from Flávio Bolsonaro. Leaked messages show Vorcaro directing his brother-in-law to make payments totaling up to US$25 million in installments, underscoring commitment to the project despite delays. The case is tied to the Master investigation, and Flávio denies wrongdoing, stating he sought only private sponsorship for a film about his father.

item.title: Flávio tenta se descolar e pede a Rubio que poupe Brasil de novo tarifaço
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) sent a letter to U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio urging the Trump administration to spare Brazil from new 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods, arguing it would harm the population amid an alleged fiscal and economic crisis. The proposed tariffs, based on Section 301 of the 1974 Trade Act, are under public consultation before potential adoption by Trump. Flávio also thanked Rubio for designating PCC and CV as terrorist organizations, seeking to distance his Washington trip from Lula’s claim that he went to 'beg for favor' from Trump to undermine him.

item.title: Flávio refaz estratégia sobre tarifaço e usa carta a Rubio para tentar conter efeito político que beneficiou Lula em 2025
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is recalibrating his electoral strategy after the U.S. proposal to impose 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods became a political liability, exploited by Lula to attack the Bolsonaro family. He recently released a letter sent to Secretary of State Marco Rubio requesting the tariffs be revoked, aiming to counter the narrative that his U.S. trip sought foreign interference against Brazil. Lula denounced Flávio as a 'traitor to the homeland' for allegedly urging foreign action against the Brazilian government.

item.title: Flávio diz que vai acionar Lula no STF por crime de ameaça, após fala sobre Tiradentes
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) announced he will file a complaint against President Lula at the STF for alleged threats, following Lula’s remarks linking Flávio and his brother Eduardo to the historical traitor Joaquim Silvério dos Reis, who betrayed Tiradentes. Lula criticized the brothers’ activities in the U.S., suggesting they prompted the U.S. to consider a 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, and equated them with traitors deserving punishment. Flávio’s office said the formal complaint will be filed today.

item.title: Lula defende Pix e diz que sistema brasileiro assusta norte-americanos
item.description: President Lula defended Brazil's Pix payment system as superior to U.S. alternatives, claiming it frightens companies like Visa and MasterCard due to being free and public. He accused the U.S. of using the USTR to target Pix with a proposed 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, despite an ongoing trade agreement. Lula said he had suggested to Trump that the U.S. adopt a similar system to Pix.

item.title: Em meio a desgaste, Flávio diz que enviou carta ao governo Trump para pedir que EUA evitem tarifas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for the 2026 presidency, sent a letter to the Trump administration requesting that the U.S. not impose 25% tariffs on Brazilian products. The move comes amid political wear and aims to prevent negative impacts on Brazil's exports.

item.title: Presidente do Senado anuncia esforço concentrado para a próxima semana
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre announced a concentrated effort next week to vote on the nomination of Benedito Gonçalves, STJ minister, as corregedor of the CNJ until 2028, with in-person sessions and the agenda to be published on Friday (5). He noted other matters may be included in the agenda and urged senators to attend to ensure quorum, as the previous vote was canceled due to insufficient turnout (59 of 67 present). Approval requires an absolute majority of 41 votes.

item.title: Flávio expõe preocupação com desgaste político ao pedir que EUA poupem Brasil de novo tarifaço; leia carta
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro sent a letter to U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio urging Washington not to impose new 25% tariffs on Brazil, citing the country's fiscal crisis and high public and private debt. The move reflects concerns that new U.S. trade sanctions could damage his presidential campaign, echoing past negative impacts of American measures on Bolsonarist allies. While he welcomed the U.S. designation of PCC and CV as terrorist groups, he warned that economic penalties could overshadow the political gains from his security-focused agenda.

item.title: Trump posta foto ao lado de Flávio e elogia: ‘um jovem inteligente que ama muito o seu país’
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump posted a photo alongside Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) on his Truth Social platform, praising him as 'a young intelligent man who loves his country very much.' The post came on the same day the USTR recommended a 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, heightening trade tensions between the two nations.

item.title: Lula faz apelo a Trump para impedir tarifaço: ‘Você me deve uma reunião’
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva directly appealed to Donald Trump to block a proposed 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, stating that Trump 'owes him a meeting' following an agreement made nearly a month ago at the White House for their teams to negotiate within 30 days. Lula said he is awaiting a call from Trump to explain the situation, emphasizing that the tariff announcement did not come from either of them.

item.title: Deputado pede ao STF investigação de Flávio Bolsonaro por suposta influência no tarifaço dos EUA
item.description: Deputy Pastor Henrique Vieira (PSOL-RJ) requested the STF to investigate Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) for allegedly influencing the U.S. tariff increase on Brazilian products following a meeting with Donald Trump. The petition seeks to include Flávio in the same criminal action already probing Eduardo Bolsonaro for coercion, based on suspicions of international articulation to economically pressure Brazil. The PGR is analyzing the request, which cites new facts such as the USTR’s 25% tariff announcement and Flávio’s social media post thanking Trump after the meeting.

item.title: Sob ameaça de 25% de tarifa dos EUA, Brasil tem prazo de mais um mês para negociar
item.description: Brazil has one more month to negotiate with the U.S. amid the threat of a 25% tariff on its exports, according to a preliminary report from the USTR’s Section 301 investigation. The document sets a timeline for consultations, including a public hearing on July 6, with deadlines for participation requests by June 22 and written comments by July 1. The Lula administration has formed a task force led by the finance and development ministers to engage U.S. officials on alleged unfair trade practices, such as favoring local payment systems like PIX and treatment of big tech companies.

item.title: Fim da 6x1: Fecomercio-MG apresenta a presidenciáveis proposta de contratação por hora
item.description: Fecomercio-MG presented the Trabalho/Hora com Direitos Garantidos (THDG) proposal to presidential candidates and legislators, aiming to end the 6x1 work schedule. The model allows hourly hiring with full CLT rights paid in advance, seeks to reduce informality, and offers flexibility for workers such as elderly, women, and youth, while permitting multiple employment links and a 15% bonus over the category's wage floor.
